_comment: Every customisation the profile CLI supports, for all four content actors
plus one filter actor. Apply with:
or one actor at a time:
Image paths are resolved relative to THIS file, so keep fedi-images/ next
to it. Images must be PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF and under 2 MB — Mastodon
rejects SVG avatars and headers, so export a raster version of the mark.
Recommended sizes: avatar 400x400 (square, it is cropped to a circle),
header 1500x500 (Mastodon crops to roughly 3:1 and to a shorter strip on
mobile, so keep anything important away from the edges).
Without --publish the profile is stored but no remote server is told.
Remove a key to leave it untouched; set it to null to clear it.

video.bio:
Face-recognition camouflage, tested in the open.

Every experiment runs locally in your browser: point a camera, change how your face looks, watch a recognition pipeline react. Nothing is uploaded.

This account posts the video experiments. https://ghostmaxxing.vecna.eu/lab.html

ghostyles.bioHtml:
Looks that break the read. Each ghostyle is a documented attempt at disrupting face recognition — with the conditions it was tested under, not a promise it holds anywhere.

Submissions welcome via the lab.

clipboard.bio: Stills, screenshots and fragments from the lab.
